title: Bangla Hate Speech Classification with Fine-tuned Transformer Models
findings: The evaluated transformer models were effective at identifying the 'Religious Hate' category in Bangla text. The language-specific model, BanglaBERT, achieved the highest F1-score (0.83) for this category, outperforming multilingual models like m-BERT (0.79) and XLM-ROBERTa (0.81).
